ink-active.$description: Link text color while being activated.

ink-focus.$description: Link text color while the link has keyboard focus.

ink-visited.$description: Link text color once the destination has been visited. Defaults to the resting ink — a distinct visited color is valuable for reference content and noisy for app navigation, so it is opt-in.

ink-visited-hover.$description: Text color of a visited link when hovered.

ink-visited-active.$description: Text color of a visited link while being activated.

ink-visited-focus.$description: Text color of a visited link with keyboard focus.

ink-current.$description: Link text color when the link points at the current page (aria-current). Reads as body text because the destination is where the reader already is.

ink-current-hover.$description: Text color of a current-destination link when hovered.

ink-current-active.$description: Text color of a current-destination link while being activated.

ink-current-focus.$description: Text color of a current-destination link with keyboard focus.

decoration-line.$description: Underline treatment at rest. Underlines are the non-color affordance that makes a link identifiable without relying on hue (WCAG 1.4.1).

decoration-style.$description: Underline style at rest (solid, dotted, dashed, wavy). Dotted reads as a softer, more editorial link.

decoration-color.$description: Underline color at rest. Muted against the text so the underline sits behind the word rather than competing with it.

decoration-color-hover.$description: Underline color on hover. Strengthening the rule is the cheapest possible hover signal — no layout moves.

decoration-color-visited.$description: Underline color for visited links. One of only two properties browsers allow :visited to change (the other is color).

decoration-color-visited-hover.$description: Underline color of a visited link when hovered. Kept separate because browsers permit visited styling only for color properties.

underline-offset.$description: Distance from the text baseline to the underline. Offsetting keeps the rule clear of descenders, which is what makes an underlined link legible.

underline-offset-hover.$description: Underline offset on hover. Growing the offset drops the rule away from the word — motion the reader feels without anything reflowing.

font-family.$description: Font family for link text. Inherits so an inline link matches the prose around it.

font-size.$description: Font size for link text. Inherits so an inline link matches the prose around it.

line-height.$description: Line height for link text. Inheriting keeps a wrapped inline link on the paragraph's own rhythm.

text-box-trim.$description: Which half-leading edges to trim off the link's text box. Untrimmed by default: trimming a link inside a paragraph misaligns it against the surrounding line box. Set `trim-both` for standalone links.

text-box-edge.$description: The font metrics text-box-trim trims to, e.g. `cap alphabetic`. Only takes effect where text-box-trim is set and the browser supports it.

display.$description: Display mode for a text-only link. Deliberately `inline`, not `inline-flex`: an inline-flex link cannot break across lines, which breaks reflow mid-sentence (WCAG 1.4.10).

display-with-icon.$description: Display mode once the link carries an icon. A link with an icon is a discrete object rather than a run of words, so flex layout is safe there.

align-items.$description: Cross-axis alignment of label and icon when the link is flex.

icon-gap.$description: Gap between the link label and its icon.

icon-size.$description: Icon size within links. Relative to the link's own font size so the icon tracks the text it accompanies.

icon-transform-hover-start.$description: Leading-icon transform on hover. Nudges away from the label (inline-start) so the pair opens outward rather than drifting sideways.

icon-transform-hover-end.$description: Trailing-icon transform on hover. Nudges away from the label (inline-end); the mirrored sign is what makes the gesture read as 'onward' rather than 'shift'.

new-tab-indicator.$description: The affordance drawn after a link that opens a new tab, as `content:` on `[target="_blank"]::after`. CSS rather than script, so it survives a blocked bundle and the pre-upgrade paint. `none` removes it; the `components.link.options.newTabIcon` config compiles into this value.

cursor.$description: Cursor style when hovering a link.

padding-inline.$description: Inline padding. Zero for inline links so they do not disturb the line; icon-only links raise it to build a tap target.

padding-block.$description: Block padding. Zero for inline links; see padding-inline.

min-inline-size.$description: Minimum inline size. Zero by default — an inline text link must not be force-grown to a 44px target inside a paragraph. Icon-only links raise this to `{a11y.min-interaction-size}`.

min-block-size.$description: Minimum block size. Zero by default; see min-inline-size for the icon-only case.

border-radius.$description: Corner radius, which the focus outline follows.

transition-duration.$description: Duration for link hover transitions. The fx duration, not the motion one: the slower spatial timing reads as lag on a color change the pointer is sitting on.

transition-timing-function.$description: Easing for link hover transitions. The playful motion curve overshoots slightly, which is what gives the icon nudge its spring.

transition-property.$description: CSS properties that animate on hover. Enumerated rather than `all` so layout properties never animate and the reduced-motion modifier has a known surface.

transition-delay.$description: Delay before link hover transitions run.

decoration-line-current.$description: Underline treatment when the link points at the current page.

decoration-line-current-hover.$description: Underline treatment of a current-destination link when hovered.

decoration-line-current-active.$description: Underline treatment of a current-destination link while being activated.

decoration-line-current-focus.$description: Underline treatment of a current-destination link with keyboard focus.

decoration-style-current.$description: Underline style when the link points at the current page.

decoration-style-current-hover.$description: Underline style of a current-destination link when hovered.

decoration-style-current-active.$description: Underline style of a current-destination link while being activated.

decoration-style-current-focus.$description: Underline style of a current-destination link with keyboard focus.

decoration-color-current.$description: Underline color when the link points at the current page.

decoration-color-current-hover.$description: Underline color of a current-destination link when hovered.

decoration-color-current-active.$description: Underline color of a current-destination link while being activated.

decoration-color-current-focus.$description: Underline color of a current-destination link with keyboard focus.

decoration-thickness-current.$description: Underline thickness when the link points at the current page.

decoration-thickness-current-hover.$description: Underline thickness of a current-destination link when hovered.

decoration-thickness-current-active.$description: Underline thickness of a current-destination link while being activated.

decoration-thickness-current-focus.$description: Underline thickness of a current-destination link with keyboard focus.

underline-offset-current.$description: Underline offset when the link points at the current page.

underline-offset-current-hover.$description: Underline offset of a current-destination link when hovered.

underline-offset-current-active.$description: Underline offset of a current-destination link while being activated.

underline-offset-current-focus.$description: Underline offset of a current-destination link with keyboard focus.
